segments.name: Job matching services
segments.description: Provides job matching and flexible employment matching services in China through the Gongwuyuan Platform.
segments.evidence: The Gongwuyuan Platform was launched in November 2019 and has since expanded its flexible employment matching services in 5 provinces and 30 cities.

revenueModel.text: Customers located in the PRC pay the company for services rendered, with receivables typically unsecured.
revenueModel.evidence: Accounts receivable are typically unsecured and derived from services rendered to customers that are located in the PRC, thereby exposed to credit risk.
